purpose: Test whether separately designed G3 mechanisms operate as one organic current-flow process in live CARLA, without optimizing a scalar driving score.

necessity_kill_search.reason: Deterministic CARLA execution, memory, counterfactual probing, and responsibility accounting alone do not establish the conjunction of current-flow relational re-participation, Participation/Reconstruction non-collapse, pre-realization responsibility control, Closure-bounded experience admission, and later re-participation in one continuous live trajectory.
non_novelty_claims: CARLA synchronous execution itself is not novel.
Counterfactual probing itself is not novel.
Responsibility attribution itself is not novel.
Memory re-use itself is not novel.

claiming full P8 irregular spiral validation

primary_questions: Does the same past relation participate differently under different current realities?
Can an old completed experience re-participate when a current relation forms without age/recency privilege?
Can individual effect be zero while joint effect is non-zero in live flow?
Do Participation and Reconstruction vary independently while remaining organically connected?
Do responsibility and verification affect the pre-realization decision process rather than acting only as post-hoc records?
Does unresolved Omega survive Completion provenance and later re-relate when current conditions make it relevant?
Is provenance preserved from source relation through participation, reconstruction, possibility, responsibility, choice, realization, outcome, closure, new experience, and later re-participation?
